summary_what_it_does: Chelsea assemblage for Extell's hotel at 112-118 W 25th St (B800 L49): Sabet Group's three lots (53, 55, 56) each sell ALL their excess rights — 23,864 + 15,070 + 14,644 = 53,578 SF — to the developer lot, which goes from 156,390 to 209,968 SF (85.17%) of the 246,540 SF FAR-10 zoning lot. Index says $0, but prepaid transfer-tax returns on the cover (RPTT $131,250 @2.625%; RETT $20,000 @0.4%) BOTH back-solve to exactly $5,000,000 (~$93.32/SF). Includes light/air easement strip on lot 53 and 59.4/40.6 bonus-rights split.
